metadata.project: Toward Reliable Early Warning of Psychological Distress
metadata.description: Master inventory of the single random seed that controls stochasticity in the thesis's primary experiment branch. Reviewers can re-run the primary experiment by combining experiment_01_baseline.yaml with this seed value.

global_seeds.note: PYTHONHASHSEED is not pinned. For bit-for-bit reproducibility across OS / Python builds, set PYTHONHASHSEED=0 (or any fixed value) in the shell before launching the experiment.

baseline.model_family: Tabular — HGBT primary, with optional LogReg / CatBoost / LightGBM backends
baseline.split_protocol: Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) with single-distress-vs-non-distress objective. Primary operating point is the backend-prefix grid at prefix ratios 0.1, 0.2, 0.3.

random_state.purpose: Master seed for the primary single-model detector (sklearn HGBT, CatBoost, LightGBM, LogReg) and the second-stage gate (LogReg, CatBoost, untuned HGBT, tuned HGBT). The same value also seeds the threshold selection over primary_threshold_grid and the gate hyperparameter search over gate_margin_grid x gate_learning_rate_grid x gate_tree_shape_tuples.
